name: Just Married
source:
Hey welcome,
Meet Emily. Not bad, right?
Well... I'm sorry, but she's married, yeah, that's a shame.
This is Jack, her husband.
A nice guy, I know.
But what should interest you more, is that he sometimes fantasizes about seeing his wife teasing other men.
She's noticed this fantasy of his, and is trying to figure out how to act about it.

[From [url=https://k4soft.itch.io/just-married]Itch.io[/url]]
